## Bug A: parseFragmentIndices returns nulls silently

Mixing a non-numeric token (`"abc"`) with valid indices should not silently leave gaps; the user expects either a warning or fail-fast.

```{.r code-annotation-fragment-indices="2,abc,6"}
library(dplyr)            # <1>
mtcars |>                 # <2>
  filter(mpg > 20)        # <3>
```

1. Load dplyr.
2. Pipe mtcars.
3. Filter rows.

## Bug B: code-line-fragment-indices with malformed token

The middle token is invalid; the corresponding clone should not silently retain whatever index Reveal.js assigned.

```{.r code-line-numbers="|1|3|5" code-line-fragment-indices="1,2,foo,6"}
x <- 1:10

y <- x^2

plot(x, y)
```
